pages.name: French Defense: Winawer Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an e5-d4 chain before e5 is played; plan 3 gave Black the doubled c-pawns (White gets them after ...Bxc3+); plan 4 vague. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: French Defense: Winawer Variation, Winckelmann-Riemer Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 4 targeted a c4-pawn that does not exist (White's doubled pawns are on c2 and c3). Rewrote plan 4; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: French: Winawer, 4.Bd3
pages.notes: Overview said 4.Bd3 prepares to recapture on c3 with the bishop (it cannot); plan 3 had bxc3 as a parser-unreadable move. Rewrote overview and plan 3; British spelling in plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: French Defense: Winawer Variation, Delayed Exchange Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 had bxc3 written so the parser cannot place it. Rewrote plan 3.

pages.name: French: Winawer, 4.a3 Bxc3+
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an h4-h5 route with the pawn on h2; plan 2 had ...Qb6 and ...Na5 with no route and ...a5-a4 from a7. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Alekhine Gambit Accepted
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White recapturing on c3 with the b-pawn when the e2-knight recaptures in the Alekhine Gambit. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plans 2-3.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Alekhine Gambit, 5.a3 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White castling short with the f1-bishop still at home and an f2-f4 push. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Mueller-Zhuravlev Gambit, 5.Qg4 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rg6 with the rook still on h8. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in plan 1.

pages.name: French Defense: Winawer Variation, Kondratiyev Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plans had White getting doubled c-pawns, but 6.Bd2 means ...Bxc3 is recaptured by the bishop; the overview missed that Bd2 unpins the knight and threatens Nxd5. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2 and 4.

pages.name: French Defense: Winawer Variation, Alekhine Gambit, Kan Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...Be7 after Black's dark-squared bishop was exchanged on c3. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling in plan 1.
